title: agent-worker: consolidate its requirements under the cap, then answer its provider notices
prior_work: First, consolidate build/requirements/agent-worker.md (91906 bytes) under the requirements cap (70000): move non-requirement text (status history, rulings, cross-references, commentary) to docs/requirements-notes/agent-worker.md, which this job owns, and keep every **R<n>** and **F<n>** line and its mark verbatim; add a test under this module's tests that asserts the set of requirement ids and unmet marks in build/requirements/agent-worker.md is unchanged by the move (compare against the ids at the start commit). Then do the provider-notice work this START lists: for each notice, decide from your own requirements what this module must do, adapt or confirm, and add a test of your own for the change, failing with it reverted where code changes. Only if consolidation cannot get the file under the cap, stop and report to BOB with a split proposal (new module ids, build/modules.json rows, build/layers.md). Edit no other module, and commit no generated file (rows.mjs, words-unreviewed.json, any dist). Where build/situations/job.md names the old tool (proc), follow this START's commands instead.

status.reason: F1 cannot be met in agent-worker's own paths, and no offline test settles it. (1) The 60s check is bio-plane/scripts/deploy-fleet.mjs:398-417 (15 polls x 4s of https://<cfg.name>.<sub>.workers.dev/version); its bound is not in this module, so 'set the bound from a measured container rollout time' is a bio-plane change. (2) The check can never pass for this member whatever the timing: agent-worker/wrangler.jsonc sets workers_dev:false and preview_urls:false (R47: reachable only through the plane's service binding), and p3dev.mjs slugMember carries workers_dev unchanged into a --test-instance deploy, so agent-worker-p3dev-l1 has no workers.dev address and the poll can only get no answer. (3) agent-worker is not container-backed: it declares no containers (R109; only DO bindings REMOTE cross-script to agent-runner, SEGMENTS, CHECKS). Its /version (src/index.mjs handleVersion) answers env.VERSION from the Worker, awaiting only remoteVersion. Proposed owner: bio-plane (deploy-fleet rollout check), to read a workers_dev:false member's /version through the plane's service binding or report it as not reachable by design instead of ROLLOUT NOT CONFIRMED; then F1 can be closed by a walk. Changing R47 instead is a ruling for Bob. Nothing changed on job/agent-worker.
